title: 3.3.1.3-dev crashes when (de-)selecting the Insulin button
symptom: In dev version 1985, the app restarts every time when clicking on the preferences button to show or deactivate the Insulin button. The other three buttons work fine. The issue occurs regardless of whether SMB or AUTOISF plugin is active.
cause: The crash was fixed by a commit, but the thread does not explicitly state the root cause. Later, a separate issue about version text readability in dark theme was discussed, but the original crash cause is not described.
fix: The crash was fixed by commit 6018b405d72ba47222e1279092b12d63c4fcc87e. For the version text readability issue, a fix was proposed in PR #3879.
